cohort: The study included all women who underwent internal iliac artery ligation for postpartum haemorrhage over a period of one year at Vani Vilas hospital, Bengaluru.
finding: Internal Iliac Artery ligation for severe postpartum haemorrhage resulted in reduced maternal morbidity and blood loss, enabling 12 of 20 women to avoid subsequent peripartum hysterectomy, and was associated with zero maternal morbidity.
